mapper.insert: insert into reading_history ( user_id, book_id, last_chapter_id, last_chapter_name, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{lastChapterId}, #{lastChapterName}, now(), #{updateTime} ) as new on duplicate key update last_chapter_id = new.last_chapter_id, last_chapter_name = new.last_chapter_name, update_time = new.update_time
mapper.select: select rh.id, rh.book_id as bookId, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, rh.last_chapter_id as lastChapterId, rh.last_chapter_name as lastChapterName, rh.update_time as updateTime from reading_history rh inner join book_info bi on rh.book_id = bi.id where rh.user_id = #{userId} order by rh.update_time desc
